requirements.summary: Nuke Town ground grime families have distinct visual depth
requirements.expected: Overlapping transparent driveway, border-path and yard grime families are vertically separated while remaining inside the existing audited ground-film window.
requirements.falsifier: Two overlapping ground families share one y depth, or the family lift moves a film outside the 0.03 m audit window.

evidence.note: The focused test proves overlapping ground families are separated and the existing offset/window assertions pass.

requirements.summary: Yard props remain on the authored front and back lawn zones
requirements.expected: The appliance bank stays in the derived west front-lawn zone, ends at the turning-head boundary without entering the road, and all solid yard props retain their existing paired authority.
requirements.falsifier: The appliance footprint leaves the derived lawn zone or enters the carriageway, or a prop loses its exact rotational partner/collider contract.

evidence.note: The focused suite proves lawn-zone placement, red north/blue south side binding, paired silhouettes and reduced-tier authority.

requirements.summary: Hob colours follow the pushed accuracy-lane house sides
requirements.expected: The accuracy lane's HF-477 constants are respected: north is the orange house and red appliance tops remain on north, while blue tops remain on the south cream/white house.
requirements.falsifier: The built north hob is not the red material, the built south hob is not the blue material, or the hob pair is detached from the authored house sides.

evidence.note: The pushed branch defines north terracotta-orange/south cream and red/blue appliance materials; the current built-arena test proves the side mapping.

requirements.summary: The obsolete interior water factory is removed
requirements.expected: The unreferenced createNuketown2PoolWaterMaterial export is absent from src/nuketown2-interior-materials.ts, while the live pool-water module remains the caller target.
requirements.falsifier: The obsolete export remains, or the live arena pool caller resolves to the removed interior module.

evidence.note: The old interior definition is absent; the only live definition/call are the replacement pool module and arena.

requirements.summary: Close-range prop and grime review stations are authored and catalogued
requirements.expected: The live Nuke Town visual definition and roster-derived viewpoint catalog cover both appliance banks, the three yard hero props, the driveway apron, border path and both wall-grime runs.
requirements.falsifier: Any requested close-range station lacks an authored runtime camera or is absent from the catalog coverage test.

evidence.command: node --test --test-name-pattern "arena roster|catalog covers every authored review camera|catalog has no stale entries" scripts/qa/arena-viewpoint-regression.test.mjs
evidence.note: The roster-derived camera and catalog checks pass for all newly authored stations.

requirements.summary: Close-range visual inspection waits for a valid owner-machine GPU window
requirements.expected: The close-range PNG set is captured and inspected only when both ComfyUI queue arrays are empty, GPU free memory is at least 3,000 MiB, and no other headless Chrome is present.
requirements.falsifier: A capture is made during another headless Chrome workload, below the GPU-free threshold, with a non-empty queue, or without visual inspection.

evidence.command: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8188/queue; nvidia-smi; inspect headless Chrome process count
evidence.note: The required 25 polls kept queue running/pending at 0 and GPU free above 3,000 MiB, but headless Chrome remained 4-12; capture remains OPEN and no PNGs were written.

requirements.summary: The techniques candidate passes its focused mechanical gates
requirements.expected: TypeScript, lane tests, camera roster checks and coplanar inspection pass without relaxing thresholds, and UNAUDITED remains 52.
requirements.falsifier: Any required focused gate fails, FINDINGS becomes non-zero, HOUSE-INTERIOR or STREET becomes non-zero, or UNAUDITED grows beyond 52.

evidence.command: npx tsc --noEmit; npx vitest run src/nuketown2-fidelity.test.ts src/collider-visual-parity-gate.test.ts src/nuketown2-vegetation.test.ts src/nuketown2-pool-water.test.ts src/nuketown2-yard-props.test.ts src/nuketown2-grime-decals.test.ts; npx tsx scripts/qa/find-coplanar-pairs.ts
evidence.note: 70 focused tests passed; coplanar output is HOUSE-INTERIOR 0, STREET 0, FINDINGS 0 and UNAUDITED 52.
